source_snapshot.procedure: Set persistent SRIOV_EN and NUM_OF_VFS using mlxconfig, power-cycle the SUT and query the network configuration by PCIe bus.
source_snapshot.criteria: The persistent parameter write succeeds and the resulting network-interface information is correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL and scope-conflicting; substitutes a runtime sriov_numvfs sysfs write with an arbitrary example count for the Master persistent mlxconfig transaction.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED/CRITICAL; requires exact PF/BDF, supported VF count, BIOS/IOMMU and NVRAM distinction, pre-state, power and recovery gates and complete PF/VF topology.

old_problem: The active review correctly found that runtime sriov_numvfs is not equivalent to the source's persistent mlxconfig operation, but left the case pending for values that can be safely parameterized and checked against per-device supported configuration and project resource limits.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA MFT explicitly documents the persistent `SRIOV_EN`/`NUM_OF_VFS` mlxconfig transaction, next-boot activation and the need to validate supported VF capacity because excessive values may prevent boot. This resolves command semantics and safety boundaries. ED-03 permits exact device/count/topology as project configuration, ED-06/ED-18 retain a full power cycle, ED-15 forbids a PASS without the project topology oracle, and ED-17 requires evidence before disruptive state change. DeepSeek's runtime-only substitution is rejected, so no unresolved source conflict remains.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row398 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2990 and its unique variant.
Applied NVIDIA MFT's documented persistent SR-IOV command and its warning that requested VF capacity must fit hardware, software, firmware and resource limits.
Kept firmware/NVRAM enablement and capacity distinct from optional runtime VF instantiation; sysfs alone cannot satisfy the Master case.
Preserved SRIOV_EN, NUM_OF_VFS, complete power-cycle activation, PCIe-bus query and full PF/VF topology verification.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row399 and verified its manifest identity; no mlxconfig, sysfs, power or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Persistent BlueField SR-IOV enablement, VF capacity and post-power-cycle topology verification
test_case.purpose: Program the approved persistent SR-IOV enable state and VF capacity for the exact BlueField PF, activate it with a full chassis power cycle and prove the signed PF/VF topology without confusing runtime instantiation with NVRAM configuration.
required_package: Approved NVIDIA MFT/mst/mlxconfig version compatible with the exact BlueField firmware
Serial/BDF/MST-device/PF/netdev/management-role map and complete pre-state configuration/topology backup
Per-device supported SRIOV_EN and NUM_OF_VFS range plus project-approved VF count and PCIe/BAR/resource capacity proof
Approved BIOS SR-IOV, IOMMU, firmware, driver and boot prerequisites
Traffic drain, independent BMC/OOB/console, full OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready power-cycle plan and exact rollback
test_case.test_command: For the immutable mapped BlueField PF, collect full mlxconfig query/support data, PCIe/IOMMU/BIOS state, `sriov_totalvfs`, `sriov_numvfs`, `lspci` and `ip -details link` baseline. After approving the exact persistent delta and resource proof, apply only `mlxconfig -d <device> set SRIOV_EN=<approved> NUM_OF_VFS=<approved>`, preserve full output/status and query next-boot values. Under a separate gate, perform one complete chassis OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready power cycle; then query the exact PCIe device and record persistent values, PF/VF PCIe enumeration, PF netdev identity, driver binding and any separately approved runtime instantiation state.
test_case.expected_result: The exact device accepts and reads back only the approved persistent SR-IOV enable/count, completes the full power cycle and returns OS ready. Post-cycle persistent values and the signed PF/VF capacity/topology match project specification, all expected functions bind correctly, management and unaffected functions remain healthy, and no disallowed resource, PCIe, driver or system-log errors occur.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target-bound pre/write/next-boot/post-cycle evidence, approved capacity proof, a complete OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready trace, and the exact signed PF/VF topology and health oracle. A sysfs write, successful mlxconfig message, generic `ip link`, guessed count or missing VF identity cannot pass.
safety_gate: Prove serial/BDF/MST/PF and management role before write; never target the sole management PF without independent access
Validate requested NUM_OF_VFS against device support, PCIe/BAR, firmware, driver and project resource limits; never guess a count
Back up complete persistent and runtime topology and preserve logs before any change
Authorize the persistent write and full power cycle separately; do not substitute a reboot or runtime sysfs action
Stop on capacity uncertainty, wrong readback, PCIe resource error, boot failure, management loss, missing function or recovery anomaly; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Immutable device/PF identity, MFT/firmware/driver versions and BIOS/IOMMU state
Supported-value/resource-capacity proof and signed SRIOV_EN/NUM_OF_VFS target
Complete pre-state, mlxconfig set output and next-boot readback
BMC/chassis OFF, ON, boot and OS-ready timestamps
Post-cycle mlxconfig, lspci, PF/VF IDs, driver bindings, sriov_totalvfs/numvfs and netdev topology
Management/health/log comparison, recovery record if used and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If write readback is wrong, do not power-cycle and restore the saved persistent values only with approval. If boot or PF/VF topology fails after activation, stop, use BMC/OOB, disable or restore the prior supported SR-IOV/count values, perform one separately authorized full power cycle and verify original PCIe/network topology. Preserve the failed state and never retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The Master persistent mlxconfig transaction remains authoritative; DeepSeek's runtime sriov_numvfs action is explicitly excluded as a substitute and may only be a separate approved post-boot step.

blocked.reason: NVIDIA defines the persistent command, activation and capacity hazard; exact target/count/resources/topology and maintenance approval are project execution inputs.
